/assets/ships/ship%20(1).png.description: A cream-and-gold pointed spaceship with a broad turquoise canopy, swept wings, twin rear engine pods, and a long brown scarf draped around its hull.

/assets/ships/ship%20(2).png.description: A rounded cream spaceship with a large circular turquoise windshield, two side engine pods, brass nose probes, a tall dorsal fin, and brown leather-like wrapping.

/assets/ships/ship%20(3).png.description: A slim cream-and-gold starfighter with a pointed nose, angular turquoise cockpit, swept wings, twin long rear engines, and a brown scarf across its fuselage.

/assets/ships/ship%20(4).png.description: A cream bird-like glider spaceship with broad curved wings, a turquoise teardrop cockpit, small side engines, brown fabric wrapping, and an ochre pennant above the cabin.

/assets/ships/ship%20(5).png.description: A cream ring-shaped spaceship with an open circular center, a small turquoise front cockpit, pointed side fins, a rear engine pod, and brown cloth tied around the hull.

/assets/ships/ship%20(6).png.description: A wooden pirate airship with a brown square sail bearing a pale skull emblem, cream hull panels, turquoise cabin windows, rope rigging, small flags, and hanging lanterns.

/assets/ships/ship%20(7).png.description: A boxy cream cargo spaceship with turquoise cab windows, bulky clustered rear engines, brass fittings, a broad front bumper, and brown straps securing its hull.

/assets/ships/ship%20(8).png.description: A narrow cream-and-gold fighter spaceship with a turquoise cockpit, four long wing-mounted cannons, clustered rear engines, and brown fabric around its central body.

/assets/ships/ship%20(9).png.description: A walking wooden cabin spacecraft on two jointed bird-like legs, with a leafy rooftop tree, a smoking chimney, round turquoise windows, hanging plants, and small lanterns.

/assets/ships/ship%20(10).png.description: A compact cream gondola spaceship with large turquoise cabin windows, brass framing, a roof-mounted spar, small rear machinery, and orange tassels hanging beneath its body.

/assets/ships/ship%20(11).png.description: A cream crescent-moon spaceship with an open dark pilot seat, a small turquoise windshield, an orange nose cap, round blue portholes, a turquoise side fin, and rear engines.

/assets/ships/ship%20(12).png.description: A beetle-like cream spacecraft with a broad turquoise glass back, orange circular front lights, curved antenna-like tubes, and short jointed landing legs with gold feet.

/assets/ships/ship%20(13).png.description: A bell-shaped cream flying craft with a tall turquoise front window, an orange pennant, a turquoise lower rim, two side fins, and a large round engine beneath its open base.

/assets/ships/ship%20(14).png.description: A rounded cream utility spaceship with turquoise cockpit glass and circular side windows, orange-rimmed front intakes, a large side engine, and three short rear rocket pods.

/assets/ships/ship%20(15).png.description: A small cream-and-turquoise rocket plane with a pointed nose, an oval blue cockpit, short swept fins, an ochre dorsal fin, and a bright orange exhaust flame.

/assets/ships/ship%20(16).png.description: A turtle-shaped cream spacecraft with a segmented turquoise shell, a rounded glass cockpit at the front, gold shell seams, small side fins, and short pointed rear engine pods.

/assets/ships/ship%20(17).png.description: A small wooden sailing airship with cream hull plates, turquoise portholes, a tall turquoise sail, an orange pennant, rope rigging, decorative tassels, and projecting spars.

/assets/ships/ship%20(18).png.description: A cream-and-turquoise pointed spaceship with an orange nose, a long blue canopy, paired rear rocket engines, swept wings with ochre tips, and brown cloth wrapped around its middle.

/assets/ships/ship%20(19).png.description: A cream sailing starfighter with a pointed nose, a turquoise canopy, broad curved wings striped in teal and cream, paired rear engines, brown wrapping, and an orange mast pennant.

/assets/ships/ship%20(20).png.description: A tall open-ring spacecraft with segmented cream-and-turquoise hull plates, a pointed front probe, a cylindrical side engine, and a long brown scarf trailing below the ring.

/assets/ships/ship%20(21).png.description: An insect-like cream spacecraft with a turquoise glass canopy, an orange nose plate, multiple pointed mechanical legs, brown armored wrapping, and a compact rear engine cluster.

/assets/ships/ship%20(22).png.description: A short cream pod spaceship with a large oval turquoise windshield, a small upper cockpit dome, a gold-rimmed side turbine, rear engine pods, and a brown scarf trailing from its hull.

/assets/ships/ship%20(23).png.description: A broad manta-ray spaceship with cream swept wings, large turquoise circular wing panels, a teardrop glass cockpit, an ochre nose rim, and a narrow raised tail.

/assets/ships/ship%20(24).png.description: A wheeled snail-shaped spacecraft with a cream-and-orange spiral shell, a turquoise front canopy, chunky wheels, small rear machinery, and a turquoise pennant above its cabin.

/assets/ships/ship%20(25).png.description: A hot-air-balloon airship with a striped turquoise-and-cream balloon, gold suspension ropes, a wooden boat-shaped cabin, turquoise windows, a hanging lantern, and an orange pennant.

/assets/ships/ship%20(26).png.description: A cream crescent-moon boat spacecraft with an open turquoise cockpit, a tall curved bow, small side fins, brass rear engines, brown straps, and a turquoise pennant.

/assets/ships/ship%20(27).png.description: A squat cream walking spacecraft with a rounded turquoise canopy, four jointed landing legs, a gold-rimmed side engine, rear equipment, and a rolled brown pack strapped to its roof.

/assets/ships/ship%20(28).png.description: A compact cream rover-like pod spaceship with a tall turquoise bubble canopy, a visible pilot seat and steering wheel, paired side engine pods, gold fittings, and an orange pennant.
